topic: Original first-order representations over dual numbers and actual adjoint cocycles

primarySources.title: The p-adic analytic space of pseudocharacters of a profinite group and pseudorepresentations over arbitrary rings
primarySources.author: Gaetan Chenevier
primarySources.locations: Sections2.24–2.29, especially the adjoint H1 deformation discussion in Remark2.29
primarySources.review: A polynomial law is a natural family on scalar extensions. Its degree and multiplication identities hold over every commutative coefficient algebra. A representation produces this family by the usual matrix determinant. Checking only the original coefficient ring would be insufficient. Continuity is expressed by continuity of characteristic coefficients.
primarySources.formalUse: Construct the actual algebraic lift/cocycle equivalence for original matrix representations over dual numbers. The strict-conjugacy/H1 quotient, continuous conditions, representability and Galois or automorphy theorems are not inferred.

primarySources.title: Symmetric power functoriality for holomorphic modular forms, II
primarySources.authors: James Newton and Jack A. Thorne
primarySources.locations: Theorem A and introductory arithmetic lifting discussion
primarySources.formalUse: The determinant construction prepares a component of the remaining arithmetic lifting route. The Galois association, deformation and patching arguments, automorphy lifting, and analytic continuation are not supplied by the new matrix identities.
